name: The Fox in the Forest
summary: Two-player trick-taking game where winning too many tricks gives zero points, rewarding careful trick management.
rules_text: The game is played with a custom deck with three suits and ranks 1-11. Play to 21 points over multiple rounds. Each round shuffle and deal 13 cards to each player. Reveal the top card of the remaining deck as the Decree Card; its suit is trump for the round. Starting player leads any card. The other player must follow the lead suit if able, otherwise may play any card. Odd-ranked cards have a special power that triggers when played. The trick winner is the highest trump if any trump was played, otherwise the highest card of the lead suit. Winner leads next trick. Cards won are kept face-down. After 13 tricks, score: 0-3 tricks = 6 points, 4=1, 5=2, 6=3, 7-9=6, 10-13=0. First to at least 21 ends the game; highest total wins.
